title: Kabir follow-ups on B3-08/B3-36: witness seq-head equivocation, signer drip, unbound-connection S3
outcome: Witness refuses to sign a second head for a seq it already signed; signer drip and unbound connections can't evade M2/S3
acceptance: push(2,H2,4) then push(2,H3,5): witness refuses the second, no ack, no line (test)
A signer line with no newline counts against the per-tick budget and closes the connection at the cap; tick time bounded under a drip (test)
An envelope on a connection with no bound agent is denied, never admitted unchecked (test)
summary: Witness refuses a second head for an already-signed seq; signer drip (unterminated reads) charges the per-tick budget via SignerService.charge and closes at cap, tick bounded; Gateway.bind added, unbound non-c-0 connection is bad_sig (stub.py: _sig_ok + bind only; nisha's tests bind c-1 in fixtures). Tests in tests/witness and tests/panel.
review: [kabir · done] Re-ran my probes. Witness: push(2,H2,4) then push(2,H3,5) -> None, no line; and after seq 3, push(2,H4,7) -> None; 2 lines total. Unbound c-1 -> sig_ok False deny bad_sig; bound to billing with a crm-signed frame -> bad_sig. Binding comes from the barrier's own conn table (c.agent_id), not frame contents. Drip: charge() runs on every read that leaves a partial line and closes at MAX_SIGNER_LINES_PER_TICK; panel test bounds the tick under 0.9 s. Native 692, container 700 green.
